sources: https://letscamp.ca/camps/ingrams-marina-campground (the operator's booking engine; ingrams.campgroundonline.org redirects here; API letscamp.ca/api/camps/ingrams-marina-campground, read 2026-10-21)

values.note: RVs $42.50 a night, $255 a week, $675 a month, tax not included. The $23 a night that the booking engine shows as its 'from' price is the tent rate (tents have a 6-night maximum).

fees.source: https://www.ingramsmarina.com/amenities ('PRICING (Tax not included)': 'Tents $23.00 per night, Maximum stay 6 nights'; 'RV's $42.50 per night, $255.00 per week, $675.00 per month'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.ingramsmarina.com/amenities ('Our amenities include groceries, laundry, ice, gas & oil, tackle, live bait, dock fishing, fish cleaning station, picnic area, bath houses, boat ramp, and boat slips') + https://www.ingramsmarina.com/ ('COIN LAUNDRY FACILITY') + Let's Camp amenities (shower, washroom, laundry), read 2026-10-21

values.note: RV and tent sites book online through the operator's Let's Camp page ('BOOK YOUR STAY'); cabins by phone only. RV sites cancelled more than 72 hours out are refunded in full. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://www.ingramsmarina.com/ ('BOOK YOUR STAY ( Must Call to Book Cabins)' -> ingrams.campgroundonline.org -> letscamp.ca/camps/ingrams-marina-campground) + Let's Camp API (allowOnlineBookings true; 'RV sites canceled before 72 hours will receive a 100% refund'; checkIn 14:00, checkOut 11:00), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Passport America Monday through Thursday only, three-night maximum, not on holidays; call (850) 627-2241 before booking to get it.

discounts.source: https://www.ingramsmarina.com/amenities ('We accept Passport America Member discount Monday thru Thursday. There is a three (3) day maximum and no holidays... Please call us at (850) 627-2241 before you book to get the PPA discount.'), read 2026-10-21

note: Marina, RV park and campground on Lake Talquin (354 Lois Lane, Quincy), with tent sites and cabins too; boat ramp, boat slips, dock fishing, fish-cleaning station, bait and tackle.
summary: Changed fees $23 -> $42.50: the operator's price list gives RVs $42.50/night ($255/week, $675/month); $23 is its tent rate (the booking engine's 'from' price). Not stated by the operator: amperage, pull-throughs, site count (hookups/pull-through left as derived). Note: dropped hookups, rig length, price and booking text.
